messages:
marta_csops: Noticing a batch of renewal-risk nudges firing for accounts with score=0.6 even though we patched the gamma weights last week. Saw ~60 emails sent overnight.
kevin_tooling: Hmm. I pushed gamma_1.2 on Friday. Do we have a migration step that updates legacy_score_hash?
sam_growth: Affected accounts are mostly migrated customers that keep old contact mapping. They should have score_override=null but many show legacy_hash present.
ivy_support: Any sample account ids? I can check whether outreach templates were the new renewal nudge.
marta_csops: acct-72b, acct-19f, acct-88z. ops-bot log: `[2026-03-23T03:12:10Z] playbook.run send_renewal_nudge run_id=rb_982 queued=1 account=acct-72b trigger=healthscore_threshold`
kevin_tooling: Looking at scoring pipeline: gamma update required rehashing feature buckets. I wrote a one-time migration script but left a guard flag `--rehash=false` for safety; looks like it remained false in prod canary rollout.
sam_growth: So the scorer is using mixed feature sets: some accounts have new gamma but old buckets -> inconsistent scores. That explains the 0.6 anomalies.
kevin_tooling: Immediate mitigation: rollback to gamma 1.1 on scorer service and pause renewal playbook. Longer fix: run rehash migration with dry-run and then flip canary.
marta_csops: Can you pause the playbook? `/playbook pause send_renewal_nudge --reason "score-mismatch hotfix"`
ops-bot: command acknowledged: send_renewal_nudge paused by marta_csops at 2026-03-23T03:30:05Z reason=score-mismatch hotfix
ivy_support: Paused. No new nudges sent since 03:30 UTC. Backfill: do we need to retract emails? Our ESP supports suppress_unsubscribe token for recall within 1 hour only.
kevin_tooling: I will rollback scorer to gamma=1.1 in the next 5m, then run a sample rehash for 1k accounts: SQL to identify mismatch: ```SELECT a.id FROM accounts a JOIN scores s ON s.account_id=a.id WHERE s.gamma_version != a.feature_hash_version;```
sam_growth: Also add check in playbook trigger: `AND a.feature_hash_version = current_gamma_version` so we won't trigger on mismatched accounts until migration completes.
marta_csops: Good. After rollback + patch, run `SELECT count(*)` of recent sends: ```SELECT count(*) FROM outbound_emails e WHERE e.template='renewal_nudge' AND e.sent_at > now() - interval '12 hours';``` Ivy, if count>30 we should run the apology flow.
ivy_support: Will monitor. I'll start the suppression listing and flag accounts for manual review.
kevin_tooling: Rollback done to gamma=1.1 on scorer-prod. Running rehash dry-run (1k sample) now on batch-job `rehash-dryrun-20260323`.
ops-bot: job queued: rehash-dryrun-20260323 id=job_774 status=running est=8m
marta_csops: Thanks. After this incident, add an automated gating test to playbook CI to assert `playbook triggers only when score source matches current scorer version`. Also add a post-deploy migration checklist entry for `--rehash=true`.
sam_growth: Agreed. I'll open a tiny RFC for the gating test and notify product.
kevin_tooling: Dry-run results: 1k sample shows 18% feature_hash mismatches. Will coordinate full rehash but will wait for ops signoff.
ivy_support: Monitoring email sends. Current count since midnight: 64 renewal_nudge emails. I'll prepare the outreach template if we need to send clarification.
marta_csops: OK team, plan: 1) Keep playbook paused, 2) Complete controlled rehash, 3) Run dedupe check, 4) Resume playbook once 99% matches. ETA initial mitigation 30m. I'll create the incident ticket and tag cs-leads.
